course_description: Includes review of control structures and data types with emphasis on structured data types. Application of object-oriented programming paradigm, focusing on the definition and use of classes along with the fundamentals of object-oriented design is also part of the discussion as well as basic analysis of algorithms, searching and sorting techniques.

course_learning_outcomes.text: develop cleaner, more efficient and more manageable programs in solving problems;
develop graphical user interfaces (GUI) for Java programs;
evaluate searching and sorting algorithms; Page | 1
apply Java’s object-oriented programming concepts in the writing and editing of various levels of applications; and
demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.
